entities.title: Dying cancels a running countdown
entities.context: In the baseline a countdown can jump a dying pilot.
entities.decision: die cancels the countdown (RULES 3, deliberate difference 5).
entities.rationale: No jump rescues a dead pilot.

entities.title: Retargeting during a countdown is range-checked
entities.summary: A new selection becomes the destination only within the fuel; fuel never goes negative.
entities.context: In the baseline a retarget beyond the fuel could take the fuel below 0.
entities.decision: Countdown::retarget accepts only 0 < distance ≤ fuel (RULES 4, deliberate difference 6).
